svg.title: Current default Quest Touch controls; detailed accessible bindings are in CONTROLS.md

g.text: DEFAULT VR MODE / QUEST TOUCH / ACTION TYPE
Hold left trigger. Wait for the bar.
Flick right stick to a category.
Center; flick to an item. Release LT.
Hold B to equip; tap B to stow.
Raise the device to your eye.
Left grip + hold B: pickup / carry.
Right grip + Y: C4 / decoy remote.
Open Edit-Controls.cmd or the launcher controls editor.
Save, then release inputs and center sticks for two seconds.
Bindings apply live. Your custom file takes priority over this card.
Menu + A hold: native-button mode. Left grip + Menu: recenter.
Full bindings, mounted controls and remaining limitations: docs/CONTROLS.md
